title: Gacha Banner Core
description: A four-image summon-banner system that keeps one pool identity consistent across featured conversion surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the featured hero and pool mood. Images 02-04 preserve that same identity across banner, card strip, and splash surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-featured-banner first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-rate-up-card-strip, 03-pity-explainer-crop, 04-summon-splash-poster. Queue may run 02-rate-up-card-strip, 03-pity-explainer-crop, 04-summon-splash-poster concurrently after 01-reference-featured-banner is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
